sourceNotes: As someone who has been working in VR for over ten years now, it’s still a relatively small community, when an exciting new project comes about it starts to permeate the ether. Around this time last year I started to hear rumblings of a luxury real estate project that was looking to create a mindblowing VR showroom experience… from people like Shane Scranton of IrisVR, Paul Debevec, Kim Baumann Larsen, Jeff Mottle, and it was finally Vikas Reddy and Jeff Powers who connected me with Jonathan for a conversation about what he was trying to pull off. I loved the scope and ambition and we got to work,
